author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Dragon Ball Super Beerus episode 4 is here and along with it comes the adaptation of just a little over 1 episode from the original Dragon Ball Super anime from back in 2015. Episodes 9 and a little bit of 8 to be exact. 

It's time for Rock Paper scissors with Oolong and of course the Super Saiyan God Ritual itself! Not to mentioned some new CGI implementations too with Shenlong (Shenron the Dragon).
